faq.a: FandomVerse is a single-page fandom portal for anime, gaming, movies, TV shows, K-Pop, comics, and manga.
Use the Search link or the search box in the navbar to search profiles and content.
You can add merchandise to the temporary cart, but checkout and payment are not included.
Bookmarks are stored in your browser using LocalStorage.

faq.q: Does the chatbot use a live AI service?
faq.a: No. The project uses a pre-scripted FAQ dataset to keep the no-backend architecture lightweight.
